sensoji.name: Senso-ji
sensoji.hours: Main hall 06:00–17:00 (Oct–Mar from 06:30) · grounds always open
sensoji.tip: Come before 08:00 to see the temple and Nakamise-dori without crowds.
sensoji.best: Early morning; cherry blossom in late March

nakamise.name: Nakamise-dori
nakamise.price_text: Free to walk · snacks from around JPY 300
nakamise.hours: Most shops about 09:00–19:00 · check on the day
nakamise.tip: Snack stalls are cash-friendly; try melonpan and ningyo-yaki as you walk to the temple.

meijijingu.name: Meiji Jingu
meijijingu.price_text: Free · inner garden about JPY 500 in season
meijijingu.hours: Sunrise to sunset (varies by month) · check on the day
meijijingu.tip: Walk the gravel path from Harajuku gate early; the forest feels quiet even on busy days.

shibuyacrossing.name: Shibuya Crossing
shibuyacrossing.tip: Watch from the station's upper walkways or a café window rather than standing in the road.
shibuyacrossing.best: After dark when the screens light up

skytree.name: Tokyo Skytree
skytree.price_text: ≈ JPY 2,100–3,100 depending on deck · book online
skytree.tip: Buy a timed ticket online and go on a clear day; clouds can hide the view.

tokyotower.name: Tokyo Tower
tokyotower.price_text: ≈ JPY 1,200 main deck · top deck extra
tokyotower.tip: The red-and-white tower looks best from outside at night; the deck view is fine but not the city's highest.

imperialpalace.name: Imperial Palace
imperialpalace.price_text: Free · East Gardens free, closed some days
imperialpalace.hours: East Gardens about 09:00–17:00 · closed Mon and Fri · check on the day
imperialpalace.tip: The East Gardens are the easy free visit; the inner palace tour needs an advance booking.

tsukiji.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
tsukiji.price_text: Free to enter · food from about JPY 500
tsukiji.hours: Most stalls about 06:00–14:00 · many closed Sunday
tsukiji.tip: Arrive before 09:00 for the best stalls; bring cash and eat where you buy.

toyosu.name: Toyosu Market
toyosu.price_text: Free to visit · tuna auction viewing free, limited places
toyosu.hours: Market about 05:00–17:00 · closed Sunday and some Wednesdays · check on the day
toyosu.tip: The tuna auction viewing deck needs an early arrival and lottery on some days; sushi shops upstairs open early.

akihabara.name: Akihabara
akihabara.tip: Compare prices across a few shops before buying electronics; many are tax-free for visitors.

takeshita.name: Takeshita Street
takeshita.price_text: Free to walk · snacks from about JPY 300
takeshita.hours: Shops about 10:00–20:00 · check on the day
takeshita.tip: Very crowded on weekends; go on a weekday morning and try a crepe.

shinjukugyoen.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
shinjukugyoen.hours: About 09:00–16:00 (to 18:30 in summer) · closed Monday · check on the day
shinjukugyoen.tip: No alcohol and no tripods; the cherry blossom season needs a timed online ticket.

goldengai.name: Shinjuku Golden Gai
goldengai.price_text: Free to walk · bars often charge JPY 500–1,500 seating fee
goldengai.hours: Bars about 19:00–late · many closed one night a week
goldengai.tip: Small bars seat a handful; check for a cover charge sign and keep groups small.
goldengai.best: Late evening, not too late on weekdays

tmgbuilding.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building
tmgbuilding.tip: A free viewpoint; go on a clear day and skip it if Mount Fuji is hidden.

tnm.name: Tokyo National Museum
tnm.hours: About 09:30–17:00 · closed Monday · check on the day
tnm.tip: Start with the Japanese Gallery; allow at least two hours.

uenopark.name: Ueno Park
uenopark.price_text: Free · museums and zoo charge separately
uenopark.hours: Always open · museums have own hours
uenopark.tip: Combine the park with the museum and a walk to Shinobazu Pond.

teamlabplanets.name: teamLab Planets Tokyo
teamlabplanets.tip: You walk barefoot through water; wear trousers you can roll up and book a timed slot.

ghibli.name: Ghibli Museum
ghibli.price_text: ≈ JPY 1,000 · timed ticket, sold in advance
ghibli.hours: About 10:00–18:00 · closed Tuesday · check on the day
ghibli.tip: Tickets sell out early; buy online well ahead and bring the named ticket holder's ID.

odaiba.name: Odaiba
odaiba.price_text: Free to walk · attractions charge separately
odaiba.tip: Ride the Yurikamome line for the bay view and walk the waterfront at sunset.

disneyland.name: Tokyo Disneyland
disneyland.hours: About 09:00–21:00 · varies by day · check on the day
disneyland.tip: Arrive at opening and use the app for queues; weekdays are quieter.

disneysea.name: Tokyo DisneySea
disneysea.hours: About 09:00–21:00 · varies by day · check on the day
disneysea.tip: Popular rides fill fast; pick two must-dos and plan around them.

mori.name: Roppongi Hills Mori Tower
mori.price_text: ≈ JPY 2,200 Tokyo City View · Sky Deck extra
mori.hours: About 10:00–22:00 (Sky Deck to 20:00) · check on the day
mori.tip: The open-air Sky Deck is the draw; go near sunset on a clear day.

ginza.name: Ginza District
ginza.price_text: Free to walk · shops and cafés vary
ginza.hours: Department stores about 10:00–20:00 · check on the day
ginza.tip: On weekend afternoons the main street closes to cars; good for a slow walk.

omotesando.name: Omotesando
omotesando.tip: Walk from Omotesando to Harajuku for architecture and cafés; quieter than Takeshita Street.

sushilunch.name: Conveyor-belt sushi lunch
sushilunch.hours: Usually about 11:00–22:00 · check on the day
sushilunch.tip: Go before noon to skip the queue; order by touchscreen and pay at the till.

ramen.name: Ramen shop dinner
ramen.tip: Buy the ticket from the machine first, then hand it to staff; cash is common.

izakaya.name: Izakaya evening
izakaya.tip: Order a few small plates to share; some places charge a small seating fee.

sumidagawa.name: Sumida River walk and cruise
sumidagawa.price_text: ≈ JPY 1,000–2,000 one-way cruise · riverside walk free
sumidagawa.hours: Cruises about 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
sumidagawa.tip: Walk the riverside promenade from Asakusa and take a boat one way for a different view.

yanaka.name: Yanaka neighbourhood walk
yanaka.tip: A quiet old-Tokyo area near Ueno; wander the cemetery and small shopping street.
